description: SWG Transform/matrix preset (D-09): 12 x f32 LE in ROW-MAJOR 3x4 order m[y][x], y:0..2, x:0..3 (48 bytes). This is a 3x4 AFFINE transform (rotation 3x3 + translation column), NOT a 4x4 matrix. Source: Iff.cpp:861 insertChunkFloatTransform and Iff.cpp:1495 read_floatTransform both iterate for y in 0..2 { for x in 0..3 }. Pure JSON sugar over the kernel (D-08).
